claims: Rick Barnes is the head coach of the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team.
Rick Barnes has held the position of head coach of the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team since 2015.
Following the 2025-26 season, Rick Barnes confirmed he will return for his 12th season.
Rick Barnes has led the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team to three consecutive Elite Eight appearances.
Rick Barnes has led the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team to multiple SEC championships.
Rick Barnes has led the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team to four Sweet 16 appearances.
In the 2025-26 season, Rick Barnes guided the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team to a 25-12 record.
In the 2025-26 season, the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team reached an Elite Eight spot.
In the 2025-26 season, the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team lost to Michigan.
Before Tennessee, Rick Barnes had a tenure at Texas.
Rick Barnes became Texas's school-record holder for wins.
Kim Caldwell is the head coach of the University of Tennessee Lady Volunteers.
A YouTube video from Rocky Top Insider dated Mar 29, 2026 shows Rick Barnes reacting to the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team's loss in the Elite Eight.
